entity: Phelps Dodge Corporation, Western Exploration Office, Arizona
summary: Phelps Dodge Corporation's Western Exploration Office in Arizona requested that miners be exempt from ORV regulations, opposing the application of Executive Order 11644 to mining vehicles. Their comment was one of at least 15 responses from mining interests on this issue. As a result of these collective mining industry comments, the Department revised its final environmental statement to except mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles.
